head_coach.name: Julian Nagelsmann
head_coach.play_style_summary: Characteristics of his tactical approach include high pressing (gegenpressing), positional fluidity, rapid transitions, and dominating possession in the opponent's half to generate frequent attacking rotations.

key_players.name: Jamal Musiala
key_players.performance_stats: Considered a pivotal, creative playmaker for Germany and Bayern Munich; known for elite dribbling, technical agility, and regular goal contributions.

key_players.name: Florian Wirtz
key_players.performance_stats: A key young star for the national team and Liverpool; highly productive in providing goals and assists, building on strong seasons in European football.

key_players.name: Nico Schlotterbeck
key_players.performance_stats: Establishes himself as a premier starting defender in Germany's backline with dominant performances for Borussia Dortmund and robust physical presence.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the tournament due to a severe right adductor tear.
Sidelined following a serious leg and knee injury sustained during a Premier League match in mid-May.
Recently managing calf problems, though expected to be fit for the main tournament as the potential starting goalkeeper.
